```plato

    //==
    // # Quadric error metrics
    //
    // Garland and Heckbert's error quadric
    // (https://doi.org/10.1145/258734.258849) is the sum, over the planes of the
    // faces around a vertex, of the squared distance to each plane — and a sum of
    // squared plane distances IS a quadratic form in homogeneous coordinates.
    // That is exactly the `Quadric` of `spatial-structures.types.plato`, whose
    // `Coefficients` is a symmetric `Matrix4x4`, so no second type is declared
    // here: the surface reading of a `Quadric` is "the points where the form is
    // zero", and the decimation reading is "the value of the form at a point".
    //
    // The plane quadrics are weighted by triangle area, which is the standard
    // practical refinement of the paper's unweighted sum: without it a fan of
    // slivers outvotes the large faces around it.

    // The quadric of one plane: the outer product of its (a, b, c, d) coefficients
    // with itself, whose form at a point is the SQUARED distance to the plane. The
    // Hesse form stores Dot(Normal, p) = Distance, so d is the negated Distance.
    PlaneQuadric(plane: Plane): Quadric
    {
        var n = plane.Normal.Vector;
        var v = Number4(n.X, n.Y, n.Z, 0.0 - plane.Distance);
        return Quadric((v * v.X, v * v.Y, v * v.Z, v * v.W));
    }
```
